description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: Hi there! We're hiring a French-speaking ADR I to join our Account Development team at Camunda. We're a tight-knit, energetic team that takes outbound seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We run structured prospecting motions, share what's working in real time, celebrate the wins together, and still allow for flexibility in the way we operate because booking a good meeting takes real work and progressing an opportunity puts ADRs at the forefront of a great GTM motion. This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time. As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion. What you will do: Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts. Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives. Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions. Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback. Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance. Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals. What you bring: Fluency in French Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection. Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads. Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes. Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach. Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it. Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution. Ability and/or willingness to use our product. Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it. description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

As an SMB Account Executive you will be responsible for owning the full sales cycle for small and medium-sized customers, from opportunity qualification through close and initial onboarding. This role focuses on velocity, disciplined execution. You will generate your own pipeline and will manage the inbound (marketing generated) opportunities. 

Your responsibilities: 

Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

  • Own the full sales cycle for SMB customers, from qualified opportunity through close.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline through self-prospecting.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on fit, urgency, and likelihood to close within defined sales cycles.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity management and forecasting in Salesforce (SFDC).

Customer Discovery & Solution Selling

  • Consult with SMB customers to understand their business objectives, supply chain needs, and operational constraints.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, value-driven Flexport solutions.
  • Demonstrate Flexport’s platform and services through structured discovery calls, remote meetings, and tailored demos.
  • Clearly articulate pricing, value, and next steps to move opportunities forward efficiently.

Closing & Onboarding

  • Lead commercial negotiations and close new business in line with revenue and volume targets.
  • Own customer onboarding and handoff by coordinating with Operations/Account Management.
  • Set clear expectations with customers on scope, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Ensure early customer success by staying engaged during initial execution phases.

description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Software Engineer within our Commodities tribe, you will lead the end-to-end integration of US inland waterway barge data into Kpler’s global cargo intelligence platform. Operating under a "you build it, you run it" philosophy, you will design robust ingestion paths, stream real-time data using Kafka, and connect barge movement models directly to our customer-facing surfaces. This role carries genuine design authority, empowering you to solve complex entity resolution problems while mentoring peers and elevating technical craft across our crews. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end integration architecture: Drive the full engineering lifecycle—from external feed ingestion and domain modeling to streaming, entity resolution, and UI distribution. Design robust ingestion & entity-resolution systems: Map incoming barge data onto Kpler reference data (vessels, zones, installations, products) using existing Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL matching patterns. Build scalable Kafka streaming pipelines: Construct event-driven contracts, schemas (Avro), deduplication mechanisms, and dead-letter queue replays with Python and Scala. Deliver data across customer surfaces: Surface integrated barge data cleanly across Elasticsearch read models, external APIs, data warehouse feeds, and the Kpler Terminal (TypeScript/Vue). Champion production quality & observability: Maintain full operational ownership of your services, setting SLOs, participating in on-call rotations, and driving post-incident improvements. Ensure data integrity & analyst alignment: Validate external feeds and integrate human-in-the-loop analyst workflows so corrections seamlessly apply to barge movements. Mentor and elevate engineering craft: Guide and mentor crew members, document architectural designs, and actively contribute to decomposing legacy estates into event-driven services. Experience & Background What you'll need (Must-haves) Production data engineering experience: ~5+ years of experience designing, operating, and maintaining data-intensive production systems with full ownership. Advanced Python & SQL expertise: Proven ability to build clean, well-bounded services within large, complex, and evolving codebases. Event-driven streaming proficiency: Hands-on experience with Kafka streaming in production, including schema management (Avro/Schema Registry), deduplication, and replay patterns. Third-party integration & entity resolution: Demonstrated background integrating external data feeds, managing schema mapping, and building data quality monitoring frameworks. Operational mindset: Direct experience managing production observability, writing documentation, and resolving incidents in a distributed system environment. Nice-to-haves Functional programming & Scala: Experience or familiarity with Scala (Kafka Streams) or a track record of rapidly mastering new languages. Geospatial & domain knowledge: Familiarity with geospatial data tools (PostGIS) or exposure to maritime, logistics, or commodities domains. Modern data stack exposure: Experience with Elasticsearch, Airflow, Snowflake/lakehouse table formats, Kubernetes, and GitOps deployments. UI/Frontend collaboration: Working knowledge of TypeScript or Vue to collaborate on user-facing terminal features. We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us? We make things happen We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile. We build together We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges. description: About Level Zero Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024—and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First—we’re pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health. Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are. We’re seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we’re assembling the best team in the world—dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions. About the Role We are excited to welcome a biosensor scientist with a strong background in electrochemical biosensor R&D and experience in working with aptamers to join our rapidly growing start-up. The ideal candidate is expected to be proficient in bench and wet chemistry techniques. Moreover, they should have sound knowledge and experience in assay development, small molecule detection, and electrode surface modifications. It is essential for the candidate to have extensive experience in aptamer-based electrochemical biosensor R&D, including the designs, operation principles, troubleshooting, and analysis. This is a full-time, in-person role primarily based in London. Some examples of what you might do: - Design, prototype, and optimize electrochemical biosensor systems, focusing on small molecule analytes and aptamer-based recognition. - Apply surface chemistry and electrode modification strategies to improve sensitivity, selectivity, stability, and biosensor performance in complex biological samples. - Translate bio-element–target interactions into measurable and reproducible sensor outputs through novel assay design. - Apply a range of electrochemical methods (voltammetry, impedimetry, chronoamperometry, etc.) to characterize and evaluate biosensor function. - Apply data-driven approaches including Python-based analysis and Design of Experiments (DoE) to streamline workflows. - Troubleshoot technical and conceptual challenges systematically and propose innovative solutions to improve performance. - Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensure experimental reproducibility and compliance with quality standards. - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (chemists, biologists, engineers, and data scientists) to advance biosensor prototypes from concept to application. - Present results clearly through written reports, oral presentations, and scientific publications. - Attend R&D-related trainings and seminars for continuous updates on the latest trend in hormone sensing technologies. What You Bring A Ph. D. degree in Electrochemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical/Materials Engineering or related discipline, with a focus in aptamer biosensors. Post doctoral experience will be a plus for this role. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in the following areas: Proven hands-on experience in biosensor design, electrochemical techniques, and surface chemistry optimisation. Proficiency in operating electrochemical instrumentation and analyzing experimental data. Demonstrated expertise with biorecognition elements, particularly aptamers, for biosensor applications. Strong knowledge of small molecule detection in biological and/or environmental samples. Practical experience in handling and analyzing biofluids. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Creative and open mindset with the ability to explore and implement novel approaches. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working in multidisciplinary teams. Nice to have: Experience with Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR), molecular docking, or structural modeling. Familiarity with automation, Python scripting, and statistical design approaches (DoE). Track record of peer-reviewed publications, patents, or industry-led biosensor projects. Who You Are We value culture as much as we value technical expertise, creating an environment that’s equal parts collaboration, curiosity, and fun. We’re a fast-paced, mission-driven young team on a quest to make a lasting impact, fueled by uncompromising integrity, unwavering support for one another, and the thrill of exploring uncharted territories. Our passion for excellence drives everything we do, and we welcome individuals who share our commitment to shaping the future. If our vision excites you, here are the qualities we look for: You live and breathe integrity, tackling challenges with honesty and transparency. You’re a self-starter who loves diving into the unknown, collaborating on complex problems, and taking full ownership of results. You excel at open, clear communication and see every piece of feedback as a springboard for growth—especially in a science and data-focused environment. You’re motivated by creating real impact, particularly when it comes to advancing human health. You strike a balance between independence and collaboration, knowing when to seek support or invite others to join in. You’re confident in defending your ideas, while also valuing respectful, constructive debate as a path to better solutions. You thrive in the dynamic atmosphere of a startup, constantly evolving your skill set and fearlessly applying what you learn. What We Offer A full-time role with a competitive salary and equity options, reflecting our value in your expertise and potential. An environment where you’ll collaborate directly with the founding team at a leading biosensor startup, gaining access to industry experts and thought leaders. The chance to grow with us, including ample opportunities for leadership, career advancement, and exploration. Travel to New York and other potential sites for R&D purposes. The excitement of working on cutting-edge technology, shaping strategic decisions, and driving innovation at an early-stage venture alongside a superstar team. Be Part of Our Journey If you're ready to be at the forefront of biosensing innovation and thrive in fast-paced, learning-rich environments, we'd love to hear from you. If your skills and experience do not align perfectly with this role, yet you believe you have something unique to offer, we're keen to listen. description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

*** We are open to candidates looking for either a six-month, full-time internship starting in January 2027, or a minimum 12-month apprenticeship starting in January 2027. ***

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Brand Design team led by Gavin Jones, Brand Design Manager. The team consists of 3 people, including this internship role, working closely with the wider Marketing organisation across the region. Together, you'll be bringing Mirakl's visual identity to life — crafting compelling, on-brand assets that support campaigns, drive awareness, and strengthen how we show up across digital and print channels.
"This is a hands-on team where you'll be involved from day one. I'll be acting as a close mentor throughout your time here, and you'll have real ownership of projects. We check in weekly as a team to review progress, tackle challenges, and share best practices. You'll also collaborate closely with the wider Marketing team and manage incoming projects through Wrike, our project management tool." — Gavin Jones, Brand Design Manager
 

2. Your Impact

  • Design visually engaging assets for digital platforms including social media, websites, and email campaigns, ensuring consistency with Mirakl's brand identity
  • Create and layout print materials such as brochures, posters, flyers, and business cards that reflect our brand standards
  • Contribute creative ideas in brainstorming sessions and support the evolution of Mirakl's visual identity
  • Edit and optimise images for web use, balancing visual impact with performance
  • Support multimedia projects including video editing or animation, as needed
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently studying or recently graduated in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative field
  • A strong portfolio showcasing a range of creative work across both digital and print formats
  • Previous experience in a tech company or start-up environment is a plus
Skills:
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • Experience with Figma or equivalent UI/UX design tools
  • Solid understanding of typography, colour theory, and layout design principles
  • Ability to produce assets for both digital and print channels
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Wrike
 

4. Tools Used

  • Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign
  • Figma
  • After Effects and/or Premiere Pro (a plus)
  • Wrike
  • AI: Dust, Claude, N8N

 

5. Languages

  • English: professional proficiency required
  • French: professional proficiency is a plus
 

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,600 per month (depending on profile)
Perks & Benefits:
  • A workplace that promotes well-being and balance: breakfasts, yoga and sports classes, after-work drinks, and game nights
  • A tailor-made onboarding experience designed to help you hit the ground running
  • Empowering and evolving responsibilities to make the most of your time here
  • A unique opportunity to join a fast-growing French unicorn and collaborate with international teams
  • Access to CSE discounts (ticketing, cultural activities, and more)
  • Gymlib pass to support your well-being
  • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (at the foot of the Eiffel Tower)
  • Swile meal vouchers card
  • 50% coverage of transportation costs (Navigo pass, bike, and more)
 

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (20 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. An initial call with the recruiter
  3. A values interview with your future manager and a member of the wider Mirakl team
The STAR method and structured interviews will hold no secrets for you.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region. This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships. You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes. What You'll Own Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development. Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality. Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution. Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems. Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability. Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions. Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations. Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar. Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale. Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat. Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems. Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery. Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure. Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability. Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production. Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues. Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams. Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes. Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes. Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track. This Role Is Not For Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology. Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance. Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start. Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes. People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues. Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled. description:
We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re Europe’s largest student rental platform. You’ll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team’s standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with Wellhub.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Le contexte Suite à une croissance rapide et rentable en France, Doctrine s'est développée en Italie et en Allemagne, puis a racheté Maïté, une legaltech espagnole, au début de l'année 2026. Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un·e Engineering Manager pour continuer à améliorer notre IA juridique sur le marché espagnol. C’est un rôle stratégique qui impactera la roadmap produit et les futurs succès de Doctrine en Espagne. À noter : le poste est basé à Paris, dans nos bureaux du 18e arrondissement. Tu trouveras le détail de notre stack technique sur Github ! Bon à savoir : une expérience professionnelle préalable dans le domaine juridique n'est pas requise. En revanche, l'envie de t'investir et de monter en compétence sur la compréhension de documents juridiques est essentielle. Les missions 🛠 Manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire (software engineers, data engineers, machines learning engineers). Motiver ton équipe, l’accompagner dans sa performance, aider tes collaborateurs dans le développement de leurs soft skills (communication, leadership) et les accompagner dans leur évolution de carrière. Être garant du suivi des projets de la squad pour délivrer dans les délais et au bon niveau de qualité. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les autres engineering managers de Doctrine Challenger les décisions techniques, aider les membres de l’équipe à grandir techniquement, accompagner l’équipe dans l’atteinte de ses objectifs, notamment en les aidant à débloquer des situations techniques Construire et maintenir un haut niveau de compréhension des problématiques métiers des membres de ton équipe, au service de ta crédibilité technique au quotidien Le profil idéal 👀 Une première expérience réussie en management d’équipe software ou data Une solide expérience en tant que que senior software engineer (fullstack developer idéalement) Un intérêt marqué pour l’humain, la bienveillance et le leadership Une capacité à partager tes connaissances et tirer tes collègues vers le haut Une bonne maitrise de la langue française Une volonté le temps que l’équipe grandisse d’être “hands on” et de contribuer au code Idéalement, des notions d’espagnol car tu seras amené à manager un équipe qui travaille sur des données en Espagne Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert. Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc. Nos valeurs 🤝 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses. Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur. Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership. Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser. Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques. Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️ 🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine. 🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles 🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne 🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers 📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise 🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être 🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an 👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan 🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois) 💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal 🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple Notre processus de recrutement 🚀 Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions. Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume. (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles) Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater ! Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins. Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature ! Diversité & inclusion Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement. Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. At Algolia, we are on a mission to help businesses connect their end-users with what matters most, in milliseconds. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing these innovations to life for Global 2000 organisations. You won’t just sell a product - you’ll guide customers through a transformation where algorithms act as strategic copilots, delivering contextual recommendations, predictive experiences, and AI-assisted user journeys that improve engagement and business outcomes.

You will own complex, high-impact relationships, lead multi-stakeholder buying cycles, and work cross-functionally to articulate the value of AI-first search, agentic automation, and composable architecture. This role demands strategic instincts, a consultative mindset, and the ability to translate AI innovation into measurable business value.

You are a builder, a challenger, and a trusted advisor. You thrive in dynamic environments and know how to position Algolia as a key enabler of AI-driven digital transformation - not just another line item in a stack.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

  • Owning, managing, and accelerating an enterprise pipeline 
  • Driving inbound and outbound opportunities through complex, multi-threaded sales cycles to closed-won
  • Positioning Algolia’s generative AI and agentic capabilities to executives and technical champions - showing how real-time relevance, predictive personalisation, and autonomous search assistants deliver business value
  • Developing territory and account strategies across your portfolio
  • Expanding existing accounts by identifying opportunities for strategic and commercial growth
  • Generating new enterprise projects by self-sourcing high-value meetings, networking within communities, and leveraging partner ecosystems
  • Partnering with Solutions Engineering to build bespoke demos, proofs-of-value, and ROI analyses that highlight impact beyond traditional search metrics
  • Forecasting accurately with disciplined methodologies (MEDDPICC) and a deep understanding of decision drivers and buyer risk profiles
  • Collaborating cross-functionally (SDRs, Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Legal, Marketing, Partners) to align execution with business outcomes and long-term enterprise value

  • 5+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals - especially in digital transformation, AI/ML, or search/commerce domains
  • A deep interest in generative AI, machine learning-enabled customer experiences, and how agentic systems unlock competitive advantage
  • Proven success selling into large, multi-department organisations with complex evaluation criteria and dispersed stakeholder influence
  • Familiarity with selling adjacent solutions or ability to quickly learn technical differentiation and articulate it to technical and executive stakeholders
  • Strong outbound sales capability, modern prospecting skills, and comfort leading with insight
  • Experience working with strategic partners (consultancies, SIs, ISVs) to co-build opportunities

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience selling platforms with usage-based pricing, AI-first capabilities, or composable architectures
  • Understanding of how generative models and agentic tools are used in commerce, discovery, and digital engagement
  • Comfort discussing technical architecture and AI relevance with technical decision makers
  • A curious, growth-oriented approach with the ability to balance strategic vision and execution rigor
  • A passion for building new ground - especially where cutting-edge AI meets real business outcomes
#LI-Hybrid

On-Target Earnings Pay Range
£148,500—£172,000 GBP

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. 

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

  • HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 

What you’ll do at Jamf:

 

The Enterprise New Logo Account Executive MEA is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.

This role is offered in The Netherlands only, preferably for candidates located in the Randstad and used to travel to MEA #LI-Remote

 

What you can expect to do this role:

 

New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development

  • Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory.
  • Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.
  • Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.

Enterprise Sales Cycle Management

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.
  • Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.
  • Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.

Commercial & Deal Execution

  • Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.
  • Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.
  • Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.

Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.
  • Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.

Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.
  • Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.
  • Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.

 

What we are looking for:

 

  • Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)
  • Professional working proficiency in English is required and Arabic is preferred.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)
  • Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)
  • Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)
  • Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)
  • Travel in the MEA territory around 40%.

 

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

 

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

 

Why Jamf?

 

  • Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.
  • 23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. 


What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. ABOUT THE ROLE Want to work at the frontier of AI and shape the most forward-looking event formats globally? Events are where TabPFN meets the world, and one of our strongest channels. We show up at the most talked-about conferences across research and industry, in cities like New York, Seoul, Paris and Sydney, with one ambition: to be the name everyone remembers on the way home. And we create our own moments, from meetups and hackathons to executive dinners people want to be in the room for, where we lead the conversation on AI for tabular data. You will be at the heart of how our events come together globally. You work hands-on with our Founders office, who owns the events strategy, and alongside sales, research and DevRel. You make sure every detail is taken care of, so every event is flawless on the day and turns into real conversations afterwards. You'll learn how a fast-growing AI company runs its events, and grow with the program as it scales. Everything we do is AI-first. We use the latest tools and aim to run events smarter than anyone else, so you'll spend less time on spreadsheets and email chains and more time on the details that make an event worth attending. If you've ever wanted to take event management to the next level, this is the place. CORE AREAS OF IMPACT The events we run Industry & academic conferences: from large-scale trade shows to NeurIPS and ICML, wherever they take place around the world Side events & community meetups: the side event everyone talks about, and the meetups and hackathons where people build with TabPFN Executive dinners & briefings: small rooms, senior guests, real conversations, from Berlin to San Francisco What you'll do across all of them Help deliver events that bring our brand and product to life: Help shape our events strategy, sponsorships and creative concepts Help shape agendas, find speakers and spot opportunities to maximise our presence, with smart ways to get people curious and excited about TabPFN Run the logistics: venues, vendors, travel, booths and merch Set up invites, Luma pages and guest communication Support the team on site and make every guest experience seamless Help build playbooks and automations, and track what each event delivered Bring the vibe: dream up experiences people talk about, from activations and live demos to gamification, installations or the right DJ. If it makes the night, it's on the table Capture content on site that brings every event to life on our social channels WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You're organised, calm under pressure and obsessed with the details guests notice. You bring a strong executor mindset and know how to build experiences for high-profile guests, from executives and researchers to media and senior partners, with the judgment to make every event feel seamless, elevated and deeply considered. You have: Essential Background 1-3 years of experience running events, ideally B2B, tech or conferences Hands-on experience with event logistics: venues, vendors, travel, guests Experience with executive dinners, conference booths or side events Great intuition and taste for what looks and feels good, you create experiences people remember and make everyone who didn't show up feel they missed out! A bias for action and experimentation: you'd rather test and learn than wait for a perfect playbook A strong collaborator: you coordinate smoothly with sales, research and DevRel An AI-first way of working: you use the latest tools to run events leaner and faster Structured and reliable: when you own something, it's handled Exceptional written and verbal communication skills Happy to travel 40%+ internationally What Makes You Special Experience in an early-stage startup or a fast-growing tech company You've worked with sales and know what makes an event useful for pipeline Familiarity with AI, ML or developer communities Experience with academic or research conferences A network of venues, agencies and vendors in Berlin, London or New York is a plus LOCATION Berlin, on-site, with frequent travel Life at Prior Labs You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right. Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together. Our Commitments The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are. Très bonne maîtrise de Python et de SQL. Très bonne maitrise du traitement de données distribué : Spark (PySpark). Solide expérience de développement de pipelines de données sur Databricks Pratique des standards d'ingénierie logicielle : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés, revue de code, performance. description: About Exa Exa is an applied AI research lab organizing the entire web for AI. Agents don't search like people do. HubSpot, monday.com, Revolut, Firefox, Cognition, Cursor and OpenRouter all build on Exa. We raised a $250M Series C at a $2.2B valuation, led by a16z with Benchmark, Lightspeed, NVIDIA Ventures and Y Combinator. If you want to build core technology that's used every day, help build a generational company, and shape the revenue engine behind it, come join us. You’ll bring our GTM operations and programs to EMEA, partnering with our Head of Revenue Programs to decide what we keep, what we localize and what we build new for the region’s markets. Know what’s working and what’s not, and work with our Insights team to spot patterns early, before they show up in the numbers. Roll out every change in EMEA, localized for our markets. Think through what each change will affect, and give each one a clear why, a playbook, training and a check-in on whether it stuck. Run EMEA’s operating rhythm: weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, QBR-style reviews and planning inputs, with decisions and follow-ups tracked. Help EMEA deals move through pricing, quoting and approvals with our US deal desk, Finance and Legal, including EMEA specifics like VAT, GDPR and local entities. Take our operations and programs from launch to running smoothly in EMEA, and adapt them to the region’s markets, languages and buying norms. Get sellers up to speed on our tools and how each one fits into how we work with buyers, and help each seller set up a day that works for them. You’re a builder and a doer who loves to optimize and organize. You’ve built processes and programs your team actually used, kept them running, and made them better. You see how the whole GTM machine fits together, including where sales and field engineering meet. You think through the downstream impact of a change before it ships. You’re AI-first and fluent in Exa and AI assistants like Claude, Devin and GrokBot. Our stack changes all the time, so you get up to speed fast on every tool, in the UI and through MCP, and you know when a moment calls for a human conversation instead. description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. description: 🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role As Head of Distribution, you own grape’s commercial engine end to end: Broker Sales, Direct Sales, Brand & Marketing, Customer Success and Revenue Operations. You carry the new nARR and renewal targets and lead the team leads who deliver them. You take this function over from our co-founder, grow it further, and represent Distribution on grape’s Leadership Team. What you'll do: Own the numbers: Deliver new nARR and renewal targets across broker, direct and partner channels. Own forecast accuracy, pipeline health and the channel mix. Lead the commercial organisation: Lead five team leads, set OKRs, hold the performance bar, develop the next layer of leaders and hire ahead of growth. Win the broker channel: Own decision-maker relationships with key broker houses and steer the tender season on quality, speed and win rate. Build the end-to-end funnel: Set clear stage ownership and KPIs from first touch to renewal. Align closely with underwriting on deal flow and pricing, and steer RevOps on tooling, data quality and forecasting. Retain and grow the book: Own the renewal rate and retention playbook, drive platform and grape connect adoption, and turn customer and broker insight into product input. Work across the company: Represent Distribution on the Leadership Team and in board reporting. Partner with Product, Insurance Supply and Operations. What you'll need: 10+ years in commercial roles, including 5+ years leading a multi-team organisation through team leads. A track record of delivering multi-million B2B revenue targets repeatedly. Experience in a B2B market sold through intermediaries; Swiss insurance, employee benefits or pensions is a strong plus. Experience scaling a commercial organisation, ideally in a venture-backed company. Strong pipeline, forecasting and funnel analytics; uses CRM (ideally HubSpot) as a steering tool. Understanding of, or a fast route to learning, insurance commercial mechanics: premium, loss ratio and renewal pricing. VBV registration, or readiness to obtain it promptly. Fluent German and English; French and Swiss German are a plus. Credible with brokers, your team and the Board; direct, data-driven and comfortable disagreeing upward. What makes you stand out: Existing relationships in the Swiss broker market. You’re both builder and operator: you write the growth model and sit in the tender review. The leaders who reported to you grew, and they stayed. 🤝 What we offer in return: 🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions. 💻 Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office. 🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home. 🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office. ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to. 🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually ❤️‍🩹 Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy. 🎫 Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams. ✈️ Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues. 🚂 Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office. 🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days. 🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs. 👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life. ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review). 🏁 Our recruitment process We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps: Step 1 - Your motivation To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team. Step 2 - Role fit In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager. Step 3 - Case study For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities. Step 4 - Our culture connect Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision. Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance. At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us. With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together. Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart, Inventing Together, and always striving to Embrace Clarity. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
