description: Mit einer Bilanzsumme von über 12 Mrd. €, ca. 1.300 Mitarbeitenden und einer über 213-jährigen Unternehmensgeschichte sind wir eines der größten und das älteste selbstständige Finanzdienstleistungsinstitut unserer Region. Gemessen an der Bilanzsumme ist die Sparkasse Karlsruhe die fünftgrößte Sparkasse in Baden-Württemberg und gehört zu den 25 größten Sparkassen in Deutschland. Wir überzeugen unsere Kunden vor Ort und digital mit individueller Beratung und bestem Service. Unser Erfolgsrezept? Der Mensch. Die Nähe zu unseren Kunden und unseren Mitarbeitenden ist unser wichtigstes Ziel. Im Beratungszentrum Stutensee beraten und betreuen Sie zusammen mit sechs weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unserer Filialleitung unsere Kundinnen und Kunden. Kommen Sie zur Sparkasse Karlsruhe – werden Sie Teil unseres Teams. Ihre Aufgaben: Kundenkontaktmanagement und Betreuung für zugeordnete Kunden Ganzheitliche und eigenverantwortliche Betreuung der zugeordneten Kunden im Rahmen unseres S-Finanzkonzeptes und unter Einbindung von Spezialisten (für Versicherungen, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Wertpapiergeschäft und Bausparen) Aktive Beratung in den Kernkompetenzfeldern Service und Liquidität, Absicherung der Lebensrisiken, Altersvorsorge, Vermögen bilden und strukturieren (vornehmlich durch eigenständiges WP-Geschäft) Anbahnungsgespräch in der privaten Baufinanzierung Pflege und Intensivierung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie Gewinnung neuer Kunden Ihr Profil: Bankfachwirt oder vergleichbare Ausbildung Aufgeschlossenheit und Freude am Umgang mit Kunden Ihre Vorteile: Eine krisensichere Anstellung bei einem starken regionalen Arbeitgeber Als tarifgebundene Arbeitgeberin wenden wir die einschlägigen tariflichen Regelungen des TVöD-AT sowie des TVöD-BT-S an. Die Vergütung erfolgt nach Entgeltgruppe 9a. Die Jahresbruttovergütung orientiert sich an der Erfahrung und Qualifikation und liegt in einer Spanne von ca. 50.598 € bis ca. 68.873 € mit 13,83 Monatsgehältern inkl. Höchstbetrag der vermögenswirksamen Leistungen Möglichkeit einer leistungsorientierten Vertriebsprämie 39 Stunden-Woche bei Vollzeit Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (ohne Wochenendarbeit und Spätdienste) 32 Urlaubstage (ab 2027: 33 Tage) + bezahlte Freistellung am 24.12. und 31.12. Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Betriebliche Krankenversicherung Unterstützung Ihrer beruflichen Aus- und Weiterbildung Fahrradleasing 50% Zuschuss zum Jobticket Weitere Vergünstigungen bei Finanzprodukten sowie exklusive Mitarbeiterangebote zu Top-Konditionen über "corporate benefits" – Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 1.500 Shops Weitere Benefits finden Sie auf unserer Homepage. Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung (bezogen auf Vollzeit) und Ihres möglichen Eintrittstermins. Bewerben Sie sich bis zum 14.12.2026. description: About Level Zero Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we’re pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health. Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are. We’re seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we’re assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions. About the Role We are seeking a lead biosensor scientist to drive the development and commercialisation of our continuous aptamer sensor platform. The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in developing continuous monitoring devices for regulated healthcare applications, demonstrated experience transitioning research-stage sensors into manufacturing-ready products, and a track record working with in vivo validation studies and large-scale analytical verification programs. This is a full-time, in-person role primarily based in London. What you'll do Lead the development and optimisation of electrochemical continuous sensor systems from bench concept through manufacturing readiness. Design and execute large-scale analytical verification studies, including multi-parameter performance characterisation, stability assessments, and biocompatibility validation. Oversee in vivo validation studies in human subjects and troubleshoot sensor performance in clinical settings. Define manufacturing processes, material specifications, and quality control parameters aligned with regulatory expectations and QMS frameworks. Engage directly with regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) to define performance specifications and shape submission strategy. Lead cross-functional efforts with electrochemistry, microfabrication, and manufacturing to translate designs into scalable production. Develop technical documentation packages (CMC, analytical performance dossiers) for regulatory submissions and investor communications. Mentor junior scientists and technicians in sensor characterisation and assay validation methodologies. What You Bring A Ph.D. degree in electrochemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or related discipline, with specific focus on electrochemical biosensors. Minimum 4 years of industry experience commercialising continuous monitoring or diagnostic sensor technologies. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in the following areas: Deep experience in electrochemical sensor development-particularly amperometric, potentiometric, or impedance-based platforms-with demonstrated progression from research concept to clinical or commercial application. Proven track record managing regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking) for continuous monitoring devices. Strong experience designing and executing large-scale analytical verification studies including stability, accuracy, precision, and matrix interference assessments. Demonstrated experience working with in vivo validation studies, including study design, data interpretation, and regulatory reporting. Knowledge of manufacturing readiness, scale-up strategy, and GMP-compatible processes. Proven ability to operate in QMS-ready environments with familiarity of ISO 13485, design controls, and regulatory compliance frameworks. Understanding of biocompatibility, sterility, and shelf-life requirements for implantable or skin-worn continuous devices. Proficiency in surface chemistry, material selection, and biointerface optimisation. Expertise in aptamer-based biorecognition elements and aptamer optimisation for continuous monitoring applications. Nice to have: Experience with microneedle or transdermal ISF technologies. Familiarity with SELEX or aptamer discovery workflows. Experience with MEMS & electrode microfabrication processes. Who You Are We value culture as much as we value technical expertise, creating an environment that’s equal parts collaboration, curiosity, and fun. We’re a fast-paced, mission-driven young team on a quest to make a lasting impact, fueled by uncompromising integrity, unwavering support for one another, and the thrill of exploring uncharted territories. Our passion for excellence drives everything we do, and we welcome individuals who share our commitment to shaping the future. If our vision excites you, here are the qualities we look for: You live and breathe integrity, tackling challenges with honesty and transparency You’re a self-starter who loves diving into the unknown, collaborating on complex problems, and taking full ownership of results You excel at open, clear communication and see every piece of feedback as a springboard for growth—especially in a science and data-focused environment You’re motivated by creating real impact, particularly when it comes to advancing human health You strike a balance between independence and collaboration, knowing when to seek support or invite others to join in You’re confident in defending your ideas, while also valuing respectful, constructive debate as a path to better solutions You thrive in the dynamic atmosphere of a startup, constantly evolving your skill set and fearlessly applying what you learn What We Offer A full-time role with a competitive salary and equity options, reflecting our value in your expertise and potential An environment where you’ll collaborate directly with the founding team at a leading biosensor startup, gaining access to industry experts and thought leaders The chance to grow with us, including ample opportunities for leadership, career advancement, and exploration Travel to New York and other potential sites for R&D purposes The excitement of working on cutting-edge technology, shaping strategic decisions, and driving innovation at an early-stage venture alongside a superstar team Be Part of Our Journey If you're ready to be at the forefront of biosensing innovation and thrive in fast-paced, learning-rich environments, we'd love to hear from you. If your skills and experience do not align perfectly with this role, yet you believe you have something unique to offer, we're keen to listen. Reach out to us with a short statement on how you can contribute and let's discuss where you might fit into our team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. The Role We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production. You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed. What You'll Own Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives. Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure. Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving. Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability. Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans. Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability. Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback. Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team. Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems. Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly. Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity. Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems. Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure. Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems. Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on. Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers. Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems. Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams. Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes. Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production. Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required. This Role Is Not For Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code. People who only want to work within one narrow technical area. Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting. Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome. Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem. People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release. Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled. The Bar We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights. A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it. You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger. Location This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely. Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Technical interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. The Role We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production. You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed. What You'll Own Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives. Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure. Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving. Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability. Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans. Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability. Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback. Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team. Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems. Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly. Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity. Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems. Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure. Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems. Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on. Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers. Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems. Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams. Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes. Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production. Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required. This Role Is Not For Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code. People who only want to work within one narrow technical area. Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting. Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome. Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem. People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release. Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled. The Bar We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights. A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it. You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger. Location This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely. Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Technical interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow. Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder. Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership. Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work. Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed. Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others. QUALIFICATIONS Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues. Working knowledge of support and incident tooling and best practices for technical support environments (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent), plus genuine enthusiasm for AI in support, ideally with hands-on experience piloting or driving adoption. Sound judgment under pressure: prioritizing by urgency, severity, and customer health context, and skilled in customer-facing crisis communication, including what to say, when, and to whom during a live incident, and how to translate root cause into clear RCAs/ISNs. Experience with enterprise-grade support: managing high-stakes accounts holistically, building trust with sophisticated customers, and thinking beyond individual ticket resolution. Strong communicator and customer advocate with a bias toward action, comfortable working independently across departments, remote teams, and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus. Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. HOW WE WORK We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote #BI-Hybrid #BI-Remote Benchling welcomes everyone. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. description: Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen? Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt. Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer. Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon. Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt. Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst. Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch. Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich. Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Deine Mission Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast. Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen. Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team. Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute. Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen. Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil. Was du mitbringen musst Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content. Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €. Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS. Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge. Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen. Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf. Was wir bieten 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt. Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events. Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen. Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen. Apple-Ausstattung, Urban Sports, Benefit-Card, Parkplatz, Team-Events. So bewirbst du dich Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und beantworte drei kurze Fragen: Links zu 1–3 Founder-Brands, für die du verantwortlich warst, welcher Umsatz darüber entstanden ist (3–5 Zeilen mit Zahlen) und dein LinkedIn-Profil. You translate the engineering BOM released by R&D into the manufacturing BOM for products, sub-assemblies and spare parts. This is a newly created role in our Operations team. First months at Vitestro In your first months, your focus will be on two things. First, you set up the change process end to end: from an engineering change to its implementation in the build, including the impact on time and cost. Second, you build the manufacturing BOMs for our products from the engineering BOMs. You structure sub-assemblies to match the assembly sequence, add consumables, packaging, labels, kitting and the make/buy split, and set up spare-part and service BOMs together with Service. description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

  • Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
  • Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
  • Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
  • Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
  • Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
  • Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
  • Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
  • Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
  • Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
  • Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

  • Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
  • No active backlogs
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
  • Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
  • A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers. Jouw rol Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Wie ben jij? description: Location: 100% remote (EMEA + South America) Classification: Full-time Pay Range: €82,000–140,000; determined by several factors, including location Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into. This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them. About Miaplaza Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful! As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations! What you’ll work on We’re a C# and Vue.js platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. How management works at Miaplaza We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before: You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable. You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first. You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output. Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too. What you must bring We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements: 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework 3+ years of experience with software architecture 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience What makes you stand out Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration Experience with consumer platforms at scale Experience building in regulated environments Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.) Extensive senior front-end development experience Responsibilities Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes. Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs Our hiring process As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time. Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update. Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role. Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far. 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work. 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it. Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership. Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report. Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law. We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder. Compensation The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area. Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know. description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product. Your Background PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues. Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data. Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare. Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale. Nice to Have Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting. Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning. Robotics or embodied AI. Simulation for data generation. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen? Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt. Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer. Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon. Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt. Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst. Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch. Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich. Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Deine Mission Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast. Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen. Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team. Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute. Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen. Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil. Was du mitbringen musst Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content. Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €. Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS. Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge. Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen. Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf. Was wir bieten 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt. Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events. Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen. Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen. Apple-Ausstattung, Urban Sports, Benefit-Card, Parkplatz, Team-Events. So bewirbst du dich Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und beantworte drei kurze Fragen: Links zu 1–3 Founder-Brands, für die du verantwortlich warst, welcher Umsatz darüber entstanden ist (3–5 Zeilen mit Zahlen) und dein LinkedIn-Profil. description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen. Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wat bieden wij jou? Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME) Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk Vakantiegeld 8% CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00 Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities Wat ga je doen: Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley. Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel) Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen. Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem. Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000 Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA) Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal) In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken? Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst. We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt. Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent. At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will support the EMEA Central Go-To-Market team as a trusted advisor to sales leaders, enabling consistent, predictable, and repeatable hyper-growth through sales discipline, streamlined processes, and a strong operating cadence. You will partner with the EMEA Central Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, Berlin, Munich, or Hamburg, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the EMEA Central Operations Lead and trusted advisor to key sales leaders, actively participating in the EMEA forecasting process, advising on changing pipeline dynamics, and challenging forecasts to ensure accuracy, predictability, and transparency.
  • Manage Area business metrics including performance, trends, headcount, and investment models, and lead the development of key sales metrics and business review materials, monitoring performance and taking action to optimize business results.
  • Drive the annual sales planning process, including Area, Regional, and District goal assignments, territory management updates, and sales compensation plan changes.
  • Identify gaps in the infrastructure needed to support Sales and develop solutions, with a strong focus on AI, that align to the team’s overall vision, while educating and training teams on key sales processes.
  • Act as an active voice that drives change with Area leadership, and align with the Global Revenue Operations team to represent the needs of the field.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 7 to 10 years of experience in Sales, Revenue, or Field Operations supporting sales teams, with a strong emphasis on enabling teams to be hyper-productive, ideally within organizations selling subscription security software.
  • Experience designing and scaling processes that support a hyper-growth business model, including documenting key processes in a publicly traded environment.
  • Proven analytical ability to turn disparate datasets into insightful analytics, including developing messaging, data visualizations, and executive-level presentations.
  • Solid experience with a key tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, MS Office, G-Suite, and AI tools.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence sales teams, build collaborative relationships across functions, and translate the complex needs of the field. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics is required, and an MBA is a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Customs Matters More Than Ever

International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.

That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.

The opportunity: 

Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.

Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.

Things we ❤️

  • Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way
  • Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows
  • Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform
  • Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases

You will:

  • Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.
  • Work on systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities and the process of moving cargo in and out of countries.
  • Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.
  • Geek out about shipping, customs regulations and logistics. (We do this often.)
  • Figure out the most efficient way for our customers and partners to participate in the process of moving freight across borders.
  • Design and build deep, complex integrations with government agencies and partners.
  • Automate archaic customs filing processes and save the operations team thousands of phone calls per week.
  • Deliver supply chain insights to logistics teams via a world-class analytics experience.
  • Create beautiful and efficient domain models for the incredibly complex world of freight forwarding.

You should have:

  • ≥ 5 years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.
  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, designers and engineers alike.
  • A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.
  • A desire to develop your tooling repertoire. We are tech-agnostic regarding candidate background, but our platform is built with Ruby.
  • Non-optional: an aptitude for learning quickly.

How we work:

  • We come to the office at two to three times a week to hang out, have lunch, white board, and collaborate
  • We have the latest and greatest hardware and software for you to work with
  • We’re agile, but not married to a single doctrine like scrum. The teams decide how they work best.
  • Stack: we’re coming from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith, and moving to React/Typescript, Kotlin Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, GRPC, Postgres, Kafka and Snowflake

What's in it for you?

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 
  • Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 
  • A defined pension contribution scheme
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our Endpoint Protection product, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (We're currently growing multiple teams and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).

The Platform group teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:

  • Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,
  • usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.

By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.

What will you do?

  • As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.
  • You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.
  • Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).
  • Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).
  • You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.
  • Working setup: Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.

What skills & knowledge should you bring?

  • Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)
  • Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools
  • Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment
  • Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
  • Attention to detail and high coding standards
  • An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

description: Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamere wereld en zien hoe nieuwe wetgeving landt in een snel groeiend bedrijf? Dan is MyWheels op zoek naar jou! Over MyWheels MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt. Als grootste elektrische mobiliteitsplatform van Nederland gaan we verder dan toegang tot een auto. Via Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) leveren onze elektrische auto’s ook stroom terug aan het energienet. Zo pakken we tegelijk de netcongestie aan en bouwen we aan de energie- én mobiliteitsvoorziening van de toekomst. ⚡ Vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam werkt een enthousiast team van zo’n 50 mensen aan dit platform. Samen bouwen we aan iets wat echt telt. Wat ga je doen? Als stagiair Privacy & Data ondersteun je ons bij het verder brengen van ons privacy-programma in de breedste zin van het woord. Je werkt mee aan onze processen en verwerkingen, en verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen van de ACM, die praktische richtlijnen geeft over hoe de Europese Data Act door Nederlandse bedrijven moet worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, die je begeleidt, en kunt steunen op zijn contacten met onze Functionaris Gegevensbescherming en de Legal Counsel van onze moedermaatschappij. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, jouw begeleider. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je houdt ons register van verwerkingen actueel en brengt onze processen en verwerkingen visueel in kaart, in gesprek met collega’s uit alle teams; Je verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen en helpt uitzoeken wat dat betekent voor MyWheels en onze deelauto’s; Je duikt in klantklachten over privacy en ontrafelt de lastige gevallen: wat is er gebeurd, en hoe lossen we het op?; Signaleren van quick wins en verbeterkansen op het gebied van privacy en data. Verbondenheid met de duurzame impact doelstellingen van MyWheels; Je hebt interesse in de praktische kant van wet-en regelgeving en dan voornamelijk op het gebied van privacy en data; Je volgt een juridische opleiding, bij voorkeur WO Rechtsgeleerdheid of HBO Rechten, maar iedere student met de juiste interesse is welkom; Je zoekt een meewerkstage om praktijkervaring op te doen; Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en leergierig en durft kritische vragen te stellen; Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Het is een pré als je al iets weet van de AVG of de Data Act. The good stuff 👇 Een stage met een duurzame missie; Een stagevergoeding van € 400 bruto per maand o.b.v. 40-urige werkweek, passend bij je werkervaring; Een open werksfeer en borrels; Ruimte voor ideeën en initiatieven; Flexibiliteit en hybride werken; Een laptop in bruikleen. Jouw werktijden Je loopt 32 tot 40 uur per week stage binnen een hybride werkstructuur. Du planst und moderierst Workshops, präsentierst Konzepte vor Stakeholdern und begründest Designentscheidungen. Design vertritt bei uns die Nutzer:innen – von Anfang an. Du baust Design-Systeme: Komponenten, Varianten, Dokumentation. Figma ist der Goldstandard, aber wir denken an morgen und sind offen für neue Wege. Developer-Handoffs mit Specs, Zuständen, Responsive-Verhalten gehören dazu. Mit Tools wie Nordcraft rücken Design und Development näher zusammen. Du denkst in messbarer Wirkung: Wir arbeiten zahlen-, daten- und faktengetrieben – A/B-Tests, Nutzerinterviews, Analytics, Heatmaps, Conversion-Funnels. Ein Go-Live ist der Startschuss, nicht das Ende. Du teilst dein Wissen und lässt dich von anderen herausfordern: Design-Reviews, ehrliches Feedback auf Entwürfe von Kolleg:innen, Wissenstransfer. Du setzt AI gezielt ein, wo sie dich schneller und besser macht: Ob bei Research-Synthese, Konzept-Exploration oder UX-Copy. Als Werkzeug, das dein Denken beschleunigt, niemals ersetzt. Qualifikation DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Konzeption und Gestaltung digitaler Produkte, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf komplexen, erklärungsbedürftigen Anwendungen. Du denkst dich in komplexe Fachlichkeit rein und übersetzt sie in Nutzererlebnisse. Du bleibst auch bei langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen neugierig, statt auf Autopilot:in zu schalten. Du bist zu Hause in Figma: Komponenten, Auto Layout, Prototyping, Design Tokens. Design-Systeme kannst du nicht nur nutzen, sondern aufbauen und weiterentwickeln. Neue Tools probierst du gerne aus. Visuelles Handwerk und Accessibility: Typografie, Farbe, Spacing, Responsive Design und Animationen – du gestaltest Interfaces, die professionell und durchdacht sind. Accessibility (WCAG) gehört für dich zur Grundhaltung. Kommunikation: Du argumentierst Designentscheidungen gegenüber Entwickler:innen, PMs und Kund:innen. Du moderierst Workshops und schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein. Deutsch auf C1-Niveau: Unsere Kund:innen und Workshops sind deutschsprachig. Englisch in Tools und Dokumentation ist selbstverständlich. Die Extras (lernen wir gerne zusammen) Datenverständnis: Heatmaps, Conversion-Daten, Nutzungszahlen – du kannst sie in Gestaltungsentscheidungen übersetzen. Kein Analytics-Profi nötig, aber die Bereitschaft, Wirkung zu messen, schon. Du verstehst, wie digitale Produkte technisch funktionieren. Technische Rahmenbedingungen machen dein Konzept besser, wenn du sie früh mitdenkst. Und du weißt, warum manche Animationsideen Entwickler:innen zum Weinen bringen. Research ist kein Fremdwort: Usability-Tests, heuristische Evaluation, Wettbewerbsanalyse – du weißt, welche Methode wann passt, und übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Designentscheidungen. Dein Lebenslauf hat Lücken, Umwege oder passt nicht zu 100%? Umso besser! Die spannendsten Geschichten sind selten geradlinig. Erzähl uns einfach, was du gemacht hast und warum – und was dich zu dieser Rolle gebracht hat. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris.
