This position is open only to candidates currently residing in the United States. Travel Requirement: 10% travel for client and company in-person meetings. Purpose of this Position The Senior Solution Architect is responsible for designing and guiding enterprise solutions that bring together Mendix applications, connected enterprise data, AI capabilities, knowledge graphs, integrations and intelligent workflows. This role serves as the technical leader for complex client engagements and establishes VeilSun's capabilities across the Siemens and Altair platform stack: Mendix, Graph Studio (formerly Altair Graph Studio and Anzo) and AI Studio (formerly Altair RapidMiner). The position requires someone who can move from business problem to technical architecture, determine how the three layers of the platform should work together, build the first versions personally, and provide hands-on guidance to the teams implementing those solutions. This person will work closely with clients, project teams, developers and practice leadership to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with business outcomes. Business Outcomes Success in this role means VeilSun can confidently design and deliver enterprise AI and knowledge graph solutions, technical teams have clear architectural direction, and clients receive solutions that effectively connect applications, enterprise data, AI and business processes. You will be measured on: Successful architecture and delivery of Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio solutions Quality, scalability, security and maintainability of solution designs Ability to translate complex business problems into clear technical approaches Effectiveness of technical leadership provided to project teams Growth of VeilSun's internal enterprise AI and knowledge graph expertise, standards, reusable patterns and delivery capabilities Ability to identify appropriate uses of AI, agents, knowledge graphs, workflow automation and traditional application logic Successful collaboration with clients, developers, project managers and other technical stakeholders Contribution to discovery, solutioning, estimation and presales activities Core Responsibilities Lead technical discovery and solution architecture for Mendix, enterprise AI and knowledge graph engagements Translate client objectives, business processes, data and system constraints into scalable technical solutions Personally build the first Graph Studio models and AI Studio pipelines on early engagements, then turn them into patterns the team can repeat Build knowledge graphs in Graph Studio: onboard data from ERP, PLM and SQL sources, design or extend ontologies, write SPARQL, deploy and tune Build and deploy machine learning pipelines and AI agents in AI Studio, AI Hub and Agent Builder, with guardrails and governance Determine how application logic, workflow automation, AI agents, machine learning and human decision making should work together within a solution Design secure and maintainable integration patterns using APIs, events, middleware and other enterprise integration approaches Provide architectural direction throughout the full delivery lifecycle, including discovery, design, implementation, deployment and support Work directly with developers to review implementations, resolve complex technical issues and reinforce development and architecture standards Ensure appropriate consideration of security, identity, permissions, governance, observability, performance and scalability Partner with project managers and client stakeholders to identify technical risks, dependencies, assumptions and tradeoffs Support estimates, technical solutioning, proposals and presales conversations for enterprise AI, knowledge graph and Mendix opportunities Establish reusable patterns, reference architectures, standards and best practices for Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio delivery Mentor Mendix developers and other technical team members as VeilSun expands its enterprise AI and knowledge graph capabilities Stay current with changes across the Mendix, Siemens and Altair ecosystems, including Graph Studio and AI Studio, and help determine when new capabilities should be adopted Decision Authority You have authority to: Define and recommend the technical architecture for assigned Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio solutions Determine appropriate architectural patterns, integration approaches and technology usage within established project and organizational constraints Recommend whether a business capability should be implemented using traditional application logic, workflow automation, AI, machine learning, agentic capabilities or a combination of approaches Establish technical standards and implementation guidance for project teams Require remediation of architectural, security, scalability or maintainability concerns that create meaningful delivery or client risk Escalate technical risks, dependencies or scope concerns that may impact successful delivery Recommend reusable components, reference architectures, tools and patterns for broader practice adoption Provide technical input into project estimates, staffing needs, delivery approaches and solution feasibility Desired Behaviors and Attributes Thinks in terms of the complete business and technical system rather than a single application or technology Is comfortable working through ambiguity and turning loosely defined business problems into clear technical approaches Balances technical sophistication with practical delivery needs and avoids unnecessary complexity Can communicate complex technical concepts clearly to developers, business stakeholders and client leadership Stays hands-on: builds, validates technical decisions and helps teams through difficult implementation challenges Approaches AI pragmatically and understands that AI is not the right solution for every problem Considers security, governance, maintainability, supportability and long-term ownership as part of architecture decisions Coaches and develops others rather than becoming a bottleneck for technical decisions Proactively identifies risks, assumptions, dependencies and areas where additional discovery is required Continuously learns as the Mendix, Siemens, Altair, enterprise AI and knowledge graph ecosystems evolve Failure Patterns We Avoid Treating enterprise AI and knowledge graph work as simply another Mendix development project Defaulting to AI or agentic solutions where straightforward application logic or workflow would be more reliable Designing technically impressive solutions that are unnecessarily difficult to build, support or maintain Building AI capabilities without sufficient attention to security, data access, governance, auditability or human oversight Creating knowledge graphs or semantic models without a clear business purpose Making architecture decisions without considering existing enterprise systems, integration constraints or client capabilities Designing in isolation without involving the developers and teams responsible for implementing and supporting the solution Allowing architectural standards to become theoretical documentation that does not influence actual implementation Becoming a required approval point for every technical decision instead of enabling teams to operate independently Overcommitting to unfamiliar platform capabilities without validating feasibility, effort or delivery risk Required Qualifications Hands-on project experience with at least two of Graph Studio (Altair Graph Studio or Anzo), AI Studio or Altair RapidMiner, and Agent Builder, or completed Siemens partner enablement on these platforms with a build to show for it Knowledge graph fundamentals: RDF, OWL and SPARQL, with SHACL a plus Mendix Intermediate Developer certification or higher with at least one Mendix application shipped, and Advanced certification within 90 days of hire Significant experience designing and delivering enterprise software solutions, including leading technical discovery and solution architecture for complex projects US person, able to pass client background checks, working US time zones Ability to travel up to 20% for client workshops and onsite engagements Preferred Capabilities Mendix Advanced or Expert Developer certification, including application design, domain modeling, integrations, security, deployment and performance Experience integrating applications with multiple enterprise systems through REST APIs, OData, events, middleware or similar technologies Experience with RDF graph platforms such as Stardog, Ontotext GraphDB or Amazon Neptune. Property graph experience (Neo4j, TigerGraph, Cypher, Gremlin) is useful background but not a substitute for RDF and SPARQL Understanding of modern AI concepts including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, context engineering, tool use and human-in-the-loop workflows Experience designing or implementing enterprise generative AI, RAG, machine learning or agentic AI solutions, with Python scripting inside pipelines Understanding of cloud architecture, identity and access management, application security, observability and enterprise deployment patterns Experience with Siemens technologies such as Teamcenter, Opcenter, NX, Polarion or Insights Hub Experience with Snowflake, Databricks or similar data platforms Experience in manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, engineering, aerospace and defense, life sciences or other complex enterprise environments Familiarity with concepts such as PLM, MES, digital thread, digital twin, BOM, engineering change management, manufacturing quality or asset lifecycle management Experience mentoring developers or providing technical leadership across delivery teams Compensation & Benefits The annual base salary range for this position is $160,000–$190,000, depending on experience. title: Senior Solution Architect, Enterprise AI & Knowledge Graphs (Mendix, Graph Studi

description: About Outreach Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. The Role We are looking for a Director of Applied Science and Engineering to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of Outreach's Knowledge Graph and contextual AI capabilities. This is a senior leadership position for someone who combines deep technical expertise in knowledge representation, graph-based learning, and reasoning systems with the ability to build, inspire, and scale a high-performing team. You will own the end-to-end technical direction of a per-tenant contextual knowledge graph that captures the full complexity of each customer's sales environment: accounts, deals, contacts, rep behaviors, competitive landscape, and the signals buried in calls, emails, and CRM activity. This graph is the reasoning backbone of the platform, powering next-best-action recommendations, deal risk signals, coaching suggestions, competitive intelligence, and agentic AI workflows. In this role, you will set the research agenda, define the architecture, hire and grow the team, and drive measurable business impact through applied science innovation. Your Daily Adventures Will Include: Technical Vision & Strategy: Define and own the multi-year technical roadmap for Outreach's Knowledge Graph platform, including entity resolution, temporal reasoning, graph-based learning, and contextual inference. Translate business objectives into a coherent applied science strategy that balances research ambition with production delivery. Team Leadership: Build, hire, and lead a team of applied scientists and research engineers. Establish team culture, research rigor, career development frameworks, and a high bar for both scientific quality and production impact. Mentor senior ICs into technical leaders. Knowledge Graph Architecture: Drive the design of per-tenant knowledge graph schemas, ontologies, and data models tailored to the sales execution domain. Own decisions on graph databases, query languages, storage engines, and tenant isolation strategies at scale. Information Extraction at Scale: Oversee pipelines that extract structured knowledge from unstructured conversational and document data (sales calls, emails, CRM notes), including coreference resolution, relation extraction, event detection, and entity linking. Reasoning & Inference Systems: Lead the development of reasoning and inference layers over the knowledge graph to power next-best-action suggestions, deal risk scoring, coaching recommendations, competitive intelligence, and agentic AI decision-making. Representation Learning & Graph ML: Direct research into graph-based models (GNNs, relational embeddings, link prediction, temporal graph networks) over heterogeneous, multi-relational graph structures to support downstream reasoning, retrieval, and recommendation tasks. Cross-functional Leadership: Partner with leaders in Engineering, Product, Design, and Data to align science investments with product priorities. Represent the applied science function in executive reviews, roadmap planning, and technical design reviews. Research-to-Production Pipeline: Establish processes and infrastructure for moving from research exploration to production deployment: experiment tracking, model evaluation frameworks, A/B testing, and continuous model improvement loops. Industry & Academic Engagement: Keep the team at the frontier of knowledge graph research. Foster connections with the academic community through conference participation, publications, and strategic academic partnerships. Our Vision Of You: PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field with a focus on knowledge representation and reasoning, graph neural networks, information extraction, recommender systems or conversational AI and dialogue systems 10+ years of experience in applied science or machine learning, with at least 3 years in a people leadership role managing teams of 5+ applied scientists or research engineers. Demonstrated track record of building and shipping knowledge graph, NLP, or graph ML systems at production scale: not just publishing papers, but delivering measurable business outcomes. Deep expertise in at least three of: knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, information extraction, graph neural networks, temporal reasoning, representation learning, or recommender systems. Strong engineering fundamentals. You can write production-quality code, not just prototype notebooks. Proficiency in Python / Golang; and graph databases or query languages (e.g., Neo4j, SPARQL, Cypher) is required. Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top applied science talent. You have grown ICs into senior technical leaders and built teams with a strong shipping culture. Executive communication skills. You can translate complex research concepts into business impact narratives for C-suite and board audiences. Comfort with deep ambiguity. You will define the problem space, not just solve well-scoped problems. You thrive when chartering new technical directions from scratch. Strong Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for research and model development initiatives, from problem formulation and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring, driving outcomes with minimal oversight. Nice To Have: Experience building multi-tenant knowledge graph systems with per-customer isolation and scale requirements. Background in sales, revenue, or B2B SaaS domains: understanding of deal cycles, pipeline management, and CRM data models. Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLM-based systems (RAG architectures, tool-augmented generation, agentic frameworks). Strong communication skills with the ability to translate research concepts into product impact for cross-functional audiences. Publications in top-tier venues (KDD, NeurIPS, ACL, EMNLP, ICLR, WWW, SIGIR, etc.) in knowledge graphs, NLP, or graph learning. Experience with graph databases at scale (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar) including performance tuning, query optimization, and multi-region deployment. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-tool integration patterns. Track record of building applied science teams from scratch (0→1 team formation). Why Join Us? Foundational Leadership: You will define how Outreach thinks about knowledge representation and contextual reasoning, decisions that shape the platform for years. This is not an optimization role; it is a charter-defining one. Greenfield Architecture: Build the knowledge graph platform from the ground up with the latitude to make foundational technical decisions on schema design, graph infrastructure, and reasoning systems. Scale & Impact: Outreach processes millions of sales interactions across 4,000+ enterprise customers. Your team's work will directly power agentic AI workflows that change how revenue teams operate globally. Executive Visibility: Direct exposure to top leadership in the company. Present research direction and results at the executive level. World-Class Team: Join a culture that values scientific rigor, engineering excellence, and intellectual honesty. Collaborate with senior engineers, product leaders, and data scientists who care deeply about getting it right. Growth into executive level: For the right leader, this role is a path to executive level as the function scales. You will shape not just the technology but the organizational structure of applied science at Outreach. Why You’ll Love It Here ● Highly competitive salary ● 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave ● Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members ● OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000 ● Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC ● 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay ● Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program ● Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military ● Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team ● Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment. Join our team and make a difference in patient care. About the Role Parachute Health is building the most complete and accurate catalog of home medical equipment and supplies in the industry, and that catalog is at the heart of our entire platform. Over the last few months, a consultant improved our in-house design standards, style guide, review practices, and an early set of universal merchandising attributes. We are now hiring someone in-house to take that work over and grow it for the long term. As our Catalog Taxonomist, you will be the expert on our taxonomy, information architecture, and catalog data model. You will serve as the catalog administrator, set and enforce catalog standards, and own catalog functionality enhancements from requirements definition and justification all the way through operational implementation. Reporting to the SVP of Merchandising Operations, you will partner closely with Operations, Product, Design, and Engineering, to make sure the catalog stays accurate, scalable, and easy to work in as we expand into new categories. A large part of this job is working shoulder to shoulder with engineers and a product manager. You will sit with the Cat Crew R&D team, translate merchandising problems into requirements they can build against, and translate technical constraints back into business impact for the rest of the organization. Just as important, you will be the person who notices when the platform is quietly costing the team time or accuracy, names that gap clearly, sizes it, and advocates for fixing it. The groundwork is fairly new, so you will have a solid base to start from and real room to decide where it goes next. You get to grow the skills of an already highly-motivated Merchandising team and make the group even stronger. You will also influence R&D strategy as we build and enhance our catalog software capabilities,and partner with our clinical division as we launch new categories together. What You'll Do Own the standards and structure of the global product taxonomy, category hierarchy, and catalog data model, and evolve them as we expand into new categories. Partner closely with the Cat Crew R&D team to shape near-term catalog software capabilities. Work directly with engineers through scoping, development, and delivery rather than handing off a spec and walking away. Own catalog functionality enhancement requirements end to end: definition, business justification, and the case for prioritization, then drive them forward with the Catalog Product Manager and Engineering. Surface gaps between what the business needs and what the platform does today. Document the workarounds people have quietly adopted, quantify what they cost in time, accuracy, or scalability, and bring that case to Product and Engineering leadership. Serve as the catalog administrator: govern attributes, values, naming conventions, and data-quality standards across the catalog. Maintain and evolve core catalog assets, including the global catalog style guide, training about existing and new functionality, glossary, and design review guide. Interview category managers and subject-matter experts to learn each category's ideal state, balanced with a curiosity about current state workarounds and platform limitations. Lead design reviews for category managers and analysts and provide effective feedback. Up-level the merchandising team's catalog and taxonomy skills, continuing the trajectory started with the contract taxonomist. Drive the standardized identification of sourcing/provenance attributes, including manufacturer, brand, and product line. Set the long-term strategic direction for catalog data management, quality, and governance, and act as the senior authority the organization consults on catalog and taxonomy decisions. Collaborate with our clinical division to launch new categories, making sure the catalog and taxonomy support new clinical use cases. Advance AI-assisted catalog tooling and workflows, such as Claude skills for catalog building and quality monitoring, and codify repeatable processes. About You Deep expertise in taxonomy, information architecture, and metadata or attribute modeling, ideally for a large, complex product catalog. Hands-on experience administering catalog or product information management (PIM) systems and defining data-quality standards. A track record of spotting business gaps and doing something about them. You notice when a process is broken or a tool is falling short, you can articulate the cost in concrete terms, and you can make the case for investment to people who did not ask for it. A track record of turning ambiguous catalog problems into clear requirements, and of justifying and prioritizing enhancement work against business impact. Strong cross-functional partnership skills, and comfort being the in-house authority who sets standards and makes the final call on catalog structure. Systems thinking and a bias to build durable processes, documentation, and tooling rather than one-off fixes. Motivated to up-level a team that is early in building these skills, and open to direct or dotted-line management as the function matures. Healthcare, DME, or medical supplies domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. Knowledge of or experience in semantic web standards OWL and SKOS is a bonus. Benefits (full-time employees) Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account 401(k) Retirement Plan Equity Incentive Plan Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces Flexible Vacation Policy Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO) Home Office and Wellness Stipend Monthly Internet Stipend Annual Learning and Development Stipend Base Salary (based on experience and level) $100,000-$145,000 California job applicants may access the Notice of Collection of Personal Information and Privacy Policy with information and rights required by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) the link here. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. This role is not eligible for employer visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and for the duration of employment. If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi! About Quantiphi Quantiphi is an award-winning, AI-First digital engineering and consulting company focused on delivering high-impact Services and Solutions that help organizations solve what truly matters. We partner with enterprises to reimagine their businesses through intelligent, scalable, and transformative AI—driving measurable outcomes at the very core of their operations. Since our founding in 2013, Quantiphi has tackled some of the world’s most complex business challenges by combining deep industry expertise, disciplined cloud and data engineering practices, and cutting-edge applied AI research. Our work is rooted in delivering accelerated, quantifiable business value—not just technology for technology’s sake. Headquartered in Boston, Quantiphi is a global organization with 4,000+ professionals serving clients across key industry verticals, including BFSI, Healthcare & Life Sciences, CPG, MFG, TME etc. As an Elite and Premier partner to leading cloud and AI platforms such as NVIDIA, Google Cloud, AWS, and Snowflake, we build and deliver enterprise-grade AI services and solutions that create real-world impact. Role: Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer Experience: 5+ years of software/data engineering experience Employment Type: Full-Time (US Remote) Work Location: US Remote (Up to 25% travel to client sites across the US) Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to design, build, and productionize knowledge graph solutions for healthcare and clinical data. Our architecture uses a hybrid graph approach, combining a Labeled Property Graph (LPG) for patient/clinical data with an RDF-based graph for clinical ontology and semantic knowledge. The role will focus on translating ontology and mapping specifications into scalable graph solutions, including data transformation, graph ingestion, concept/entity linking, provenance, validation, and querying. You will work closely with ontology, terminology, FHIR, clinical/domain, and data engineering teams to translate agreed semantic and mapping decisions into robust technical implementations. Key Responsibilities: Develop, implement, build, and maintain production knowledge graph solutions across LPG and RDF graph technologies. Build scalable pipelines to transform healthcare/FHIR data into appropriate graph representations. Implement mappings between patient/clinical data and concepts represented in the clinical ontology. Develop reusable mapping and transformation patterns rather than one-off implementations. Implement consistent approaches for entity identity, canonical identifiers/URI/IRI, relationships, and concept linking. Maintain provenance and traceability between source data, mapping rules, and resulting graph entities and relationships. Develop and optimize graph queries using Cypher and/or SPARQL. Implement automated validation and testing to identify unresolved mappings, inconsistent relationships, and other graph-quality issues. Work with ontology, FHIR, terminology, and clinical SMEs to clarify ambiguous or missing mapping requirements. Participate in technical design, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices. Required Qualifications: 5+ years of software/data engineering experience, including hands-on experience with knowledge graphs or graph technologies. Strong understanding of knowledge graph and graph data modeling concepts. Hands-on experience with either:Labeled Property Graphs, such as Neo4j/Cypher or equivalent, orRDF/semantic technologies, such as RDF/RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL. Working knowledge of, or ability to work across, both LPG and RDF graph models. Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or similar languages. Experience building production data ingestion, transformation, or integration pipelines. Experience with graph databases and/or RDF triple stores. Understanding of entity identity, graph relationships, mappings, provenance, and data quality. Ability to translate conceptual models and mapping specifications into production implementations. Ability to work effectively with evolving requirements and cross-functional technical/domain teams. Other Qualifications (OQs) Hands-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs. Healthcare or life sciences data experience. Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, including concepts such as Coding, CodeableConcept, Reference, and Identifier. Experience with ontology-driven data integration or semantic mapping. Experience with SHACL or other graph/semantic validation approaches. Experience with terminology/concept normalization and canonical concept mapping. Familiarity with clinical terminologies such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS. Cloud and CI/CD experience. What Sets You Apart? Hands-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs. Healthcare or life sciences data experience with familiarity with HL7 FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS). Experience with ontology-driven data integration, semantic mapping, and SHACL/semantic validation approaches. Cloud and CI/CD engineering experience in production environment. Upskill and discover your potential as you solve complex challenges in cutting-edge areas of technology alongside passionate, talented colleagues. Work where innovation happens - work with disruptive innovators in a research-focused organization with 60+ patents filed across various disciplines. Stay ahead of the curve, immerse yourself in breakthrough AI, ML, data, and cloud technologies and gain exposure working with Fortune 1000 companies. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! description: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Tech Lead for the Frontend Platform Team provides technical leadership for Xsolla’s core platform responsible for powering all user-facing experiences. This role combines deep engineering expertise with people leadership, guiding a team of approximately eight developers. The Tech Lead shapes the platform’s architecture, improves developer workflows, and ensures high-quality, scalable solutions that support storefronts, widgets, and other monetization-focused experiences used across the Xsolla ecosystem. This position requires strong frontend and platform-level experience, the ability to lead complex technical initiatives, and the capability to support predictable, reliable delivery. ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com. Responsibilities: Provide technical leadership for the Xsolla frontend platform, defining architecture, coding standards, and long-term technical direction. Coach, mentor, and manage a team of ~8 developers, supporting professional growth and maintaining a strong engineering culture. Partner closely with the other Tech Leads working on the same platform to ensure architectural alignment, consistent standards, and unified decision-making. Oversee planning and execution of platform features and improvements, ensuring smooth delivery and high-quality outcomes. Drive modernization, refactoring, and performance enhancements to keep the platform scalable, maintainable, and aligned with product goals. Establish and enforce engineering best practices across coding, documentation, testing, and review processes. Collaborate with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and platform teams to deliver cohesive partner-facing experiences. Ensure strong automated test coverage and reliable CI/CD workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery predictability. Leverage automation and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate development, improve consistency, and increase developer velocity. Own operational excellence, including incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements. Advocate for scalability, performance, security, and observability across the platform’s architecture and tooling. Identify technical risks, estimate complexity, and communicate trade-offs to leadership and stakeholders. Foster alignment with other engineering teams on shared services, APIs, rendering pipelines, and platform interfaces. Qualifications & Skills: 8+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in modern frontend engineering at scale. At least 3 years in a similar tech lead role. Deep hands-on knowledge of React including component architecture, SSR patterns, RSC, and complex UI data flows. Proficiency with and MongoDB for server-side functionality. Strong understanding of modern styling systems and theming approaches (vanilla-extract, styled-components, design tokens). Solid TypeScript practices, including strict typing, shared contracts, and schema validation (Zod or equivalent). Experience with Module Federation Good understanding of bundling and compilation, experience with webpack/rollup/vite/esbuild. Experience with automated testing frameworks (Vitest/Jest) and end-to-end testing (Playwright/Cypress). Good understanding of backend integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, RPC-style APIs). Experience with CI/CD workflows (GitLab CI or similar), private registries, and secure artifact handling. Proven ability to lead engineers, own architectural decisions, and manage delivery for complex platform projects. Nice to Have: Experience building platforms or tooling used across multiple frontend teams (design systems, template engines, configuration frameworks). Experience with react-native/mobile experience Knowledge of performance optimization strategies for client-side and server-side rendering. Understanding of accessibility, internationalization, and semantic UI design best practices. Experience developing SDKs, CLI tools, or developer-facing automation. Familiarity with event-driven UI flows, real-time interfaces, or edge-rendering strategies. Background improving developer platforms, observability stacks, or performance monitoring systems. Comfort with UI-as-data approaches and leveraging AI-assisted/no-code tooling to accelerate feature delivery. Benefits:We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes medical, dental, and vision, PTO, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the Fair Chance Act. Criminal History Consideration: For the Tech Lead - Frontend Platform Team, we will conduct a background check that may include the following: Criminal history check Employment verification Education verification Relevance to Job Responsibilities: The background check is relevant to this position because of the following role responsibilities: Accessing confidential company data Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements Handling sensitive financial information/managing budgets/accessing funds Rights Under the Fair Chance Act: Applicants are encouraged to inquire about their rights under the Fair Chance Act. In this role you will partner with internal stakeholders to translate complex requirements into end‑to‑end machine‑learning pipelines, integrate large‑language‑model capabilities, and drive research‑focused innovations that accelerate AI adoption enterprise‑wide. Your expertise in Python, the data‑science lifecycle, deep‑learning fundamentals, and emerging generative‑AI technologies will empower you to deliver high‑impact, mission‑critical solutions that generate measurable value for Lockheed Martin. Knowledge of the data‑science lifecycle, big‑data concepts, deep‑learning fundamentals, and reinforcement‑learning ideas. Basic awareness of Generative AI capabilities such as large‑language models (LLMs) Demonstrated initiative and research mindset – comfortable navigating documentation, exploring new tools, and proposing ideas. Strong problem‑solving and communication skills; able to work with internal customers to gather requirements and provide clear status updates. Knowledge‑graph or ontology work (SPARQL, embeddings, graph‑based feature engineering). Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and OpenShift. Ability to quickly absorb new tools, applications, or approaches from documentation or public repositories and contribute ideas to the team. Research‑oriented mindset – conducting industry/academic research, networking with peers, and surfacing innovative strategies. Breadth of interest or experience with diverse data‑application domains (structured, unstructured, time‑series, sensor, etc.). Experience with Git fundamentals (branching, merging, pull‑requests, basic workflow conventions). Understanding of RESTful APIs and ability to integrate them into data pipelines. Basic familiarity with Docker (or comparable container technology). description: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Team: Product Engineering at Neo4j GraphAware offers a unique opportunity to build real-world intelligence systems that matter. We are aiming to hire someone in the the UK, Czechia or Italy. Build with purpose: Your code will help law enforcement and analysts save lives and protect communities through better data insight. Innovative tech: Work with knowledge graphs, workflow engines, LLMs, and graph-native UIs pushing the boundaries of data analytics. Shape the future: Contribute to product direction and technical vision alongside a senior engineering team. True autonomy: Own your work, from ideation to deployment, in a remote-first team. Global mindset: Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, data scientists, and product thinkers across Europe and beyond. Growth without bureaucracy: Develop your skills in a non-micromanaged, excellence-driven environment The Role: As a Senior Software Engineer, you will shape the core intelligence of GraphAware Hume, our graph-powered analytics platform. Your responsibilities will include: Building APIs for intuitive user interaction with complex data Designing secure, scalable access control systems for mission-critical environments Orchestrating workflows to automate graph analytics, inference, and real-time insights Optimizing application performance and collaborating with other engineers to ensure seamless user experiences Contributing to architecture and technical design with the team What you must know already and be excited to grow further Proven experience in backend systems (8+ years) with exposure to large-scale, complex applications and cross-functional teams Fluency in Java, with a deep understanding of modern software engineering principles, including: Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Test-Driven Development (TDD) Advanced debugging and profiling techniques, Writing composable, maintainable, and testable code Spring or similar frameworks with emphasis on building secure, modular, and scalable APIs Experience designing data models, both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and ideally graph-based (Neo4j or similar) Working knowledge of modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and automated deployment workflows Strong security mindset, with practical knowledge of secure software design and common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP) Comfortable with remote team collaboration, i.e. tools and practices for asynchronous communication Bonus points for familiarity with: Graph technologies: Cypher, Neo4j, knowledge graph Event-driven architectures, Kafka, or distributed systems Cloud-native development, observability, and performance tuning Experience working with LLMs or integrating AI/ML into production systems Why Join Neo4j? Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. description: *** This position is contingent upon contract award *** SOSi is seeking an Ontologist to support mission requirements for a structured approach to further develop, integrate, and sustain a scalable, federated data ecosystem that enhances interoperability, governance, and mission-driven analytics for a DoD customer. The primary objective of the program is to bridge the operational gaps between DoD, IC, interagency, and non-traditional international partners to enable real-time information sharing, dynamic data integration, and mission-tailored analytical capabilities. Essential Job Duties: Develop, refine, and maintain domain-specific ontologies to support structured data integration, semantic search, and AI-assisted decision support. Enforce adherence to W3C standards and metadata alignment between Databricks Unity Catalog, GIS metadata systems, and operational data stores. Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to ensure ontology-driven tagging and entity resolution enhances the relevance of research outputs. Submit the Ontology Governance & Standardization Report, detailing ontology updates, integrations, and compliance with metadata standards. Master’s degree or higher (e.g., Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Information Science, Artificial Intelligence, Geospatial Science, GIS, Data Science, Business Analytics, Cognitive Science, or a closely related field; OR a minimum of 11+ years of experience in ontology development, semantic technologies. Possess the knowledge and capability to develop ontologies: Proficiency in writing advanced SPARQL queries. Strong skills in the W3C Web Ontology Language (OWL). Solid understanding of Basic Formal Ontology (BFO) and Common Core Ontologies (CCO). Proficiency in both Java and Python for ontology-driven application development Experience with Bash scripting for automation tasks. Hands-on experience with ESRI data tools, including ArcGIS. Background in DevSecOps practices, version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively. Demonstrated expertise in ontology design, semantic data modeling, and SPARQL query development, with proficiency in W3C standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL) and supporting frameworks like Basic Formal Ontology (BFO) and Common Core Ontologies (CCO). Working Conditions Remote. Offsite. Working at SOSi All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason. Founded in 1989, SOSi is among the largest private, founder-owned technology and services integrators in the defense and government services industry. We deliver tailored solutions, tested leadership, and trusted results to enable national security missions worldwide. Originally posted on Himalayas

Strong communication skills; must be able to effectively and clearly communicate vision and objectives with the team and stakeholders. Strategic thinker with the demonstrated ability to align design goals with key objectives and priorities. description: About us We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem. We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us? Your new role - The Strategic Sales Manager within the Digital Science Enterprise Segment drives top-line revenue growth by owning the full commercial sales cycle across our integrated portfolio, including Dimensions, Altmetric, ReadCube, Figshare and Metaphacts. This role is responsible for driving pipeline generation, rigorous deal qualification, framing client-centric value propositions, aligning portfolio solutions with enterprise strategic objectives and leading pricing and contracting negotiations. High priority is placed on a solid conceptual and domain understanding of Knowledge Graph architecture, Semantic ontologies,the Semantic Layer, and Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate brings a proven sales track record in Life Sciences and excels at bridging high-level enterprise data integration discussions with executive procurement and budget cycles. Technical skills are desired but not required. What you’ll be doing Pipeline Generation & Prospecting Proactively identify, target and initiate strategic conversations with C-suite leaders, R&D executives, and data architects across Life Sciences, BioPharma and research-intensive enterprises. Execute territory plans to build a high-volume, high-quality sales pipeline across the full Digital Science capability set. Position Digital Science's unique portfolio advantage, leveraging connections between grants, patents, publications, clinical trials and knowledge graphs. Deal Qualification & Opportunity Management Apply structured qualification frameworks to evaluate enterprise leads and focus resources on high-probability opportunities. Manage and prioritize enterprise opportunities based on deal value Map complex decision-making structures to identify executive sponsors, budget holders and technical evaluators Seek up-sell and cross-sell opportunities by partnering with Account Managers and Customer Engagement Managers Coordinated pitches and responses to request for proposals (RFPs) Value Proposition Development & Value Alignment Articulate a compelling, value-based sales narrative focused on the "why" rather than just the "how" Translate complex conceptual capabilities—such as Semantic Web standards, open research workflows, and patent analytics—into clear ROI, de-risked R&D, and accelerated discovery for C-suite leaders. Align Digital Science enterprise solutions with the client’s internal digital transformation, AI readiness and knowledge management strategies. Pricing & Contracting Negotiation Navigate enterprise procurement, legal and security review cycles effectively to optimize deal velocity. Lead commercial negotiations, proposal creation, price positioning and contract execution Structure multi-product enterprise agreements that maximize deal value, protect margins and establish long-term customer retention Portfolio Cross-Selling & Internal Collaboration Act as the commercial lead across products (Dimensions, Altmetric, ReadCube, Figshare and Metaphacts) Leverage internal resources, including Pre-Sales Specialists (Solutions Architects), Product thought leaders and Marketing resources. Partner closely with colleagues during pre-sales discovery, proof-of-concept (PoC) designs and technical validations Work alongside Account Managers to ensure smooth post-sale transitions and identify account expansion opportunities What you’ll bring to the role Track Record: 5+ years of demonstrated success in enterprise B2B SaaS sales, solution consulting or strategic account management with a proven record of hitting quota targets. Negotiation Skills: Proven experience navigating multi-stakeholder procurement and structuring high-value enterprise software contracts Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and data concepts to executive audiences Domain Expertise (Preferred) Enterprise Information Architecture: Demonstrated commercial or domain familiarity with Enterprise Information Architecture (EIA) frameworks and semantic modeling is highly desired, enabling you to articulate how unifying siloed enterprise data assets into a semantic layer powers context-rich decision intelligence and Agentic AI workflows. Knowledge Graphs & Ontologies: High priority on solid domain understanding of knowledge graphs, semantic ontologies, linked data, and the role of the Semantic Layer in enterprise AI and R&D. Life Sciences Focus: Strong preference for experience selling software, scientific data or intelligence platforms into Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical or Biotech accounts. Industry Standards: Familiarity with Resource Description Framework (RDF) concepts and Open Access (OA) publishing models. Technical Background (Desirable) Technical proficiency or hands-on data skills (e.g., SPARQL, Python, graph databases) are a bonus/desired, but not required. The primary focus is commercial execution paired with domain fluency. Travel Willingness and ability to travel 20%–40% for customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry conferences. We're looking for people who are naturally curious about AI and comfortable exploring how it can improve the way we work — you don't need to be an AI expert, but an openness to experiment and adapt is important to us. Don't worry if you don't meet every qualification—let us be the judge! Studies show that many qualified candidates from under-represented groups hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team and strongly encourage you to submit your application. Living our Values We invest in, nurture and support innovative businesses and technologies that make all parts of the research process more open, efficient and effective. The talent we secure is fundamental to us achieving our vision and our growth plans. The values we live by are: We are brave in the pursuit of better We are collaborative and inclusive We are always open-minded We are from and for the community At Digital Science, our vision is to see research flow seamlessly – trusted, collaborative, and accessible – fueling breakthroughs that push humanity forward. This ambitious mission is one we achieve together, by enabling open, collaborative, inclusive research. We firmly believe that to truly innovate and solve the complex challenges faced by our customers, from researchers and universities to funders and publishers, we need diverse perspectives, experiences, and ideas. A rich mix of voices drives quality insights, fosters enhanced collaboration, and ultimately pushes knowledge forward more effectively. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building and nurturing a workplace where every individual feels valued and belongs. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Beyond recruitment, we strive to cultivate an environment where inclusivity is woven into the fabric of our culture, enabling everyone to be their best self and do their best work. description: About Outreach Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. About the job: We are looking for an Associate Applied Scientist to join a dynamic and innovative AI platform team. If you are passionate about applying machine learning to knowledge graphs and reasoning systems at scale, this is an opportunity to build core components of Outreach's per-tenant knowledge graph while developing deep expertise under the guidance of senior scientists. Our team is building a per-tenant contextual knowledge graph that captures the full complexity of each customer's sales environment: accounts, deals, contacts, rep behaviors, competitive landscape, and the signals buried in calls, emails, and CRM activity. This graph powers contextual reasoning across the platform, driving next-best-action recommendations, deal risk signals, coaching suggestions, and competitive intelligence. In this pivotal role, you will design the underlying representations, extraction pipelines, and reasoning layers that make this possible, working closely with cross-functional engineering and product teams to deliver innovative, scalable, and reliable AI capabilities with direct impact on revenue outcomes. This role is ideal for someone with strong ML fundamentals who wants to build deepexpertise in knowledge graphs and applied NLP in a fast-moving product environment. Your Daily Adventures Will Include: Key Responsibilities: Knowledge Graph Design & Construction: Design and implement entity resolution and ontology population within established graph schemas. Write and optimize queries for graph traversal and feature extraction. Own data quality for assigned domains. Information Extraction: Build pipelines that extract structured knowledge from unstructured conversational and document data (sales calls, emails, CRM notes), including coreference resolution, relation extraction, and event detection. Run experiments to compare approaches and improve accuracy metrics. Contextual Reasoning & Recommendation: Implement graph traversal logic and feature queries that feed downstream scoring signals. Build and maintain features for deal risk, next-best-action, or coaching recommendation surfaces. Representation Learning: Train and evaluate link prediction and node classification models using established graph embedding methods. Implement evaluation pipelines and track model performance over time. Domain Modeling: Translate sales concepts, such as deal stages, buyer engagement patterns, rep behaviors, and account health, into graph nodes and relationships under the guidance of senior scientists. Contribute to ontology design and documentation. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with software engineers to deploy models and pipelines into production. Write clean, tested code. Monitor system health and respond to incidents. Participate in code review and design discussions. Our Vision of You: Qualifications: PhD in a relevant field such as Computer Science, NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline with a focus on knowledge representation and reasoning, information extraction and relationship extraction, graph neural networks, recommendation systems, or conversation AI and dialogue systems. MS + 2 years of relevant experiecne will also be considered. Solid engineering fundamentals. You can write production-quality code, not just prototype notebooks. You can write clean, tested Python code. Experience with graph databases or query languages (e.g., Neo4j, SPARQL, Cypher). Demonstrated ability to build and evaluate ML models. You've trained models, measured performance using appropriate metrics, and iterated on results. description: wie du die welt von morgen prägen kannst Wissen modellieren: Du sprichst mit Fachexpert:innen aus unterschiedlichen Abteilungen, verstehst deren Domänenwissen und übersetzt es in formale, semantische Modelle. Brücken bauen: Du agierst als zentraler Übersetzer zwischen den Fachbereichen und und unserem Engineering Team. Du stellst sicher, dass das Wissensmodell sowohl die fachliche Realität abbildet als auch technisch exzellent umsetzbar ist. Konzepte gestalten: Du entwirfst und moderierst Workshops, um gemeinsam mit Stakeholdern ein einheitliches Verständnis (eine "Shared Language") für zentrale Geschäftskonzepte zu entwickeln und zu etablieren. Datenquellen integrieren: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering Team zusammen, um die Anbindung von Datenbanken, APIs und anderen Quellen an den Knowledge Graphen konzeptionell zu begleiten. Ontologien entwickeln und pflegen: Mit Standards wie OWL/RDF erstellst du nicht nur das Modell, sondern definierst auch die logischen Regeln und Constraints, die die Qualität und Konsistenz unseres Knowledge Graphen sicherstellen. was dich auszeichnet Leidenschaft für Struktur und Logik: Du denkst abstrakt und liebst es, komplexe Zusammenhänge in klare, formale Strukturen zu überführen. Deine Fähigkeit, vom Konkreten zum Abstrakten zu gelangen, zeichnet dich aus. Erfahrung in der Modellierung: Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Modellierung, z. B. mit UML oder idealerweise bereits mit semantischen Technologien (RDF, OWL). Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe technische und logische Modelle so erklären, dass sie sowohl für Fachexperten als auch für Entwickler verständlich und überzeugend sind. Du hörst exzellent zu und stellst die richtigen Fragen. Technisches Grundverständnis: Du weißt, wie Daten in Systemen fließen. Begriffe wie APIs, Datenbanken und Datenpipelines sind dir nicht fremd. Erste Erfahrungen mit Graph-Technologien (z. B. SPARQL, Cypher) sind ein großes Plus, aber kein Muss. Neugier und Gestaltungswille: Du hast den Antrieb, nicht nur bestehende Systeme zu verwalten, sondern eine neue Art der Wissensorganisation für KI von Grund auf mitzugestalten und voranzutreiben. dich erwartet ein team, das Vertrauen lebt. Wir glauben daran, dass du selbst am besten weißt, wie, wann und wo du produktiv bist. Ob Homeoffice, Co-Working-Space oder zeitweise im europäischen Ausland - du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinen Bedürfnissen. Wenn wir uns treffen, sind unsere Events echte Highlights, die uns als Team noch enger zusammenbringen. Neugier fördert. Lernen hört bei uns nie auf. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln - mit Zeit, Budget und einem Umfeld, das Austausch und Weiterdenken fördert. Neugier ist für uns kein "Nice-to-have", sondern ein zentraler Wert. Co-Creation inspiriert. Bei digetiers gestaltest du nicht nur deine eigene Rolle, sondern auch unser Unternehmen aktiv mit. Ob in Projekten, Prozessen oder unserer Kultur - deine Ideen zählen. Wir glauben an mutige Mitgestaltung statt starrer Strukturen. Mit Leidenschaft professionell arbeitet. Wir lachen gerne - und liefern trotzdem auf höchstem Niveau. Spaß und Leistungsbereitschaft schließen sich bei uns nicht aus, sondern beflügeln sich gegenseitig. Als Musketiere zusammenhält. Einer für alle, alle für einen - bei digetiers ist das nicht nur Ursprung unseres Namens, sondern gelebte Realität. Wir gewinnen als Team und halten uns gegenseitig den Rücken frei. wie du die welt von morgen prägen kannst Wissen modellieren: Du sprichst mit Fachexpert:innen aus unterschiedlichen Abteilungen, verstehst deren Domänenwissen und übersetzt es in formale, semantische Modelle. Brücken bauen: Du agierst als zentraler Übersetzer zwischen den Fachbereichen und und unserem Engineering Team. Du stellst sicher, dass das Wissensmodell sowohl die fachliche Realität abbildet als auch technisch exzellent umsetzbar ist. Konzepte gestalten: Du entwirfst und moderierst Workshops, um gemeinsam mit Stakeholdern ein einheitliches Verständnis (eine "Shared Language") für zentrale Geschäftskonzepte zu entwickeln und zu etablieren. Datenquellen integrieren: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering Team zusammen, um die Anbindung von Datenbanken, APIs und anderen Quellen an den Knowledge Graphen konzeptionell zu begleiten. Ontologien entwickeln und pflegen: Mit Standards wie OWL/RDF erstellst du nicht nur das Modell, sondern definierst auch die logischen Regeln und Constraints, die die Qualität und Konsistenz unseres Knowledge Graphen sicherstellen. was dich auszeichnet Leidenschaft für Struktur und Logik: Du denkst abstrakt und liebst es, komplexe Zusammenhänge in klare, formale Strukturen zu überführen. Deine Fähigkeit, vom Konkreten zum Abstrakten zu gelangen, zeichnet dich aus. Erfahrung in der Modellierung: Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Modellierung, z. B. mit UML oder idealerweise bereits mit semantischen Technologien (RDF, OWL). Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe technische und logische Modelle so erklären, dass sie sowohl für Fachexperten als auch für Entwickler verständlich und überzeugend sind. Du hörst exzellent zu und stellst die richtigen Fragen. Technisches Grundverständnis: Du weißt, wie Daten in Systemen fließen. Begriffe wie APIs, Datenbanken und Datenpipelines sind dir nicht fremd. Erste Erfahrungen mit Graph-Technologien (z. B. SPARQL, Cypher) sind ein großes Plus, aber kein Muss. Wir glauben daran, dass du selbst am besten weißt, wie, wann und wo du produktiv bist. Ob Homeoffice, Co-Working-Space oder zeitweise im europäischen Ausland - du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinen Bedürfnissen. Wenn wir uns treffen, sind unsere Events echte Highlights, die uns als Team noch enger zusammenbringen. Neugier fördert. Lernen hört bei uns nie auf. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln - mit Zeit, Budget und einem Umfeld, das Austausch und Weiterdenken fördert. Neugier ist für uns kein "Nice-to-have", sondern ein zentraler Wert. Co-Creation inspiriert. Bei digetiers gestaltest du nicht nur deine eigene Rolle, sondern auch unser Unternehmen aktiv mit. Ob in Projekten, Prozessen oder unserer Kultur - deine Ideen zählen. Wir glauben an mutige Mitgestaltung statt starrer Strukturen. Mit Leidenschaft professionell arbeitet. Wir lachen gerne - und liefern trotzdem auf höchstem Niveau. Spaß und Leistungsbereitschaft schließen sich bei uns nicht aus, sondern beflügeln sich gegenseitig. Als Musketiere zusammenhält. Einer für alle, alle für einen - bei digetiers ist das nicht nur Ursprung unseres Namens, sondern gelebte Realität. Wir gewinnen als Team und halten uns gegenseitig den Rücken frei. title: Knowledge Engineer / Ontologist (m/w/d)

description: Who we are: Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers. Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; and copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work. All of this frontline work is powered by a trusted knowledge base that provides the right information, processes, and systems for every interaction. We also build the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale. Who you are: You are a hands-on knowledge engineer growing into a team lead, well versed in the full knowledge graph development lifecycle. You turn the scattered knowledge behind customer service, such as knowledge articles, policies, product information, troubleshooting guides, and case history, into a single, trusted source of truth that AI agents, service agents, and customers can rely on. You formulate real-world service problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and knowledge graph solutions, working across the lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, and deployment. You design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, apply current methods with the right architecture, and stay current with knowledge engineering, generative AI, LLMs, and multimodal models, looking for ways to apply them to the problem at hand. You explain the value of knowledge graph and AI approaches in plain language, share what you learn with the team, and begin to guide junior engineers. You collaborate with business users, engineers, architects, and designers to deliver your part of an end-to-end solution. The work: Assess a client's service knowledge landscape: where knowledge lives today across knowledge bases, document repositories, CRM and ticketing systems, and agent notes, and where it is duplicated, conflicting, or out of date. Build knowledge graph components that consolidate service knowledge into one source of truth and contribute to transforming the client's data architecture. Design and maintain service ontologies and taxonomies that model products, customer issues, symptoms, resolutions, policies, and entitlements, so knowledge can be found, connected, and reasoned over. Build ingestion and curation pipelines that turn unstructured content, such as articles, manuals, policies, and interaction transcripts, into structured, governed knowledge. Make the knowledge base the trusted input for AI, preparing and structuring knowledge for retrieval through knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, and vector search, so virtual agents, agent-assist copilots, and analytics agents give accurate, consistent, and current answers. You work closely with the AI Solution Engineering teams who build those agents. Build governance into the knowledge itself, including ownership, versioning, review cycles, and access rules that separate customer-facing content from internal-only guidance. Mine service interactions to find knowledge gaps, such as questions customers ask that neither AI nor service agents can answer well, and feed them back into content creation and curation. Design, develop, and implement AI and semantic solutions, and make sure your work integrates cleanly with the broader system, working alongside Enterprise AI Architecture teams on connections to service platforms. Build solid working relationships with client counterparts, including knowledge managers and service operations teams, and work alongside the project team and delivery leads. Help assemble the supporting evidence for the recommended semantic layer solution, and support Accenture sales efforts when called on. Keep developing your skills in cutting-edge Data & AI solutions, especially agentic technologies, and share what you learn with the team. Here's what you'll need: 3+ years of experience working on customer service, contact center, or customer experience projects or operations, with an understanding of how knowledge quality affects service outcomes such as first-contact resolution, average handle time, containment, and CSAT. At least 3 of the following: Minimum 2 years of experience with knowledge graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL). Minimum 2 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 2 years of designing and developing knowledge graph solutions and graph-based ML models (functional and technical). Minimum 1 year of experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementation for AI applications (especially LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 2 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases. Bonus points if you have: Experience with service knowledge management platforms such as Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow Knowledge Management, eGain, or Zendesk, or with content repositories such as SharePoint and Confluence. Familiarity with Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) or similar knowledge management practices. Experience with GraphRAG or other knowledge-grounded retrieval for AI agents. 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). 2+ years of experience in Python, with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch and tools for building ETL pipelines, such as Apache NiFi or Airflow. Practical experience with NLP and/or search techniques, prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications. Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems. Team lead experience. External client-facing consulting experience. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams in multiple time zones.
